newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya police kill students in riot, television.
newsitem.headline: Kenya police kill students in riot, television.

text.p: Kenyan police on Wednesday shot dead two students during a riot at Kenyatta University on the outskirts of Nairobi, commercial Kenya Television Network (KTN) reported.
It said the two were shot when riot police opened fire as students protested at the killing on Tuesday of a student at Egerton University in Njoro, 200-km (125-miles) northwest of Nairobi.
A police spokesman said he could not confirm the Wednesday killings.
But an editor at KTN said students were marching 15-km (10- miles) to Nairobi from Kenyatta University to bring the bodies of their colleagues to Nairobi University's Chiromo mortuary.
He said police snatched cameras and film from a KTN cameraman who had filmed the riot and the two slain students.
Students at Nairobi University near the capital's main commerical district protested against Tuesday's killing and police reinforcements were sent in after the reported deaths at Kenyatta University.
Kenyan police spokesman Peter Kimanthi said the student at Egerton, Kenya's leading agricultural school, was shot on Tuesday when students tried to snatch guns from 20 policemen.
"Police fired in the air to disperse the students but unfortunately one stray bullet hit the student who was declared dead on arrival at a hospital," Kimanthi told Reuters.
He said students stopped their wounded first year colleague from being given first aid and denied access to medical staff.

The Egerton University students were protesting over a refund of 504 shillings ($9.89) they said each of them was owed by the administration The students also wanted one of their leaders, remanded by a court for inciting violence, released.
